I really love the Cyborg RAT7 and MMO7 mice, but they break. A lot. Constant issues with buttons going bad. Have to recommend avoiding those.
I don't think I've ever heard of that brand of mouse. Shame that they break so often.

I like my Corsair M65. Using their software you can set five different DPI settings that can be swapped using a couple buttons below the scroll wheel. On the side where your thumb goes is a forward and back button and one button that changes your DPI for what they call "Sniper Mode" I never use it but it can be programmed to do other stuff.
